definitions.explanation: Handwriting that is messy, illegible, or lacking in aesthetic quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悪筆|あくひつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: He is famous for his bad handwriting.
His handwriting is so bad that many characters are unreadable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{悪筆|あくひつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{薬剤師|やくざいし}→薬剤師：07030_yakuzaishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor's prescription was so poorly written that the pharmacist had trouble reading it.

notes:
A compound of {悪|あく} (bad) + {筆|ひつ} (brush/writing). In Japan, where calligraphy (⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧) is part of school education, handwriting quality is taken more seriously than in many other cultures. Having {悪筆|あくひつ} can be seen as a minor social embarrassment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪筆|あくひつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧: famous for bad handwriting
- {悪筆|あくひつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す: to fix one's bad handwriting
- ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{悪筆|あくひつ}: terrible handwriting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{達筆|たっぴつ}→達筆：26860_tappitsu⟧: beautiful handwriting; fine penmanship — the opposite; a compliment for skilled calligraphy
- ⟦{癖字|くせじ}→癖字：28674_kuseji⟧: idiosyncratic handwriting — not necessarily bad, just distinctive or hard for others to read
- ⟦{乱筆|らんぴつ}→乱筆：26287_ranpitsu⟧: messy writing — often used as a humble apology for one's own handwriting in letters
